name: roxy-ae-agent
description: Roxy AE Agent - AI production system for Adobe After Effects (MCP server + After Effects UXP plugin / CEP extension)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @roxy/mcp-server && npm run build -w @roxy/ae-plugin && npm run build -w @roxy/ae-cep-plugin
scripts.install:cep: npm run build:cep && npm run install-ext -w @roxy/ae-cep-plugin
scripts.sideload:plugin: npm run build:plugin && npm run sideload -w @roxy/ae-plugin
